title: Container Bookings: No-Show Fee Rates and Portfolio Thresholds by Tier
content:
Every Container Bookings product sets a per-container no-show fee and a portfolio threshold. The threshold is the tally of no-show fees, taken over all of a customer's bookings for the last 90 days, that closes the product to fresh requests from that customer.

| Booking product | No-show fee (USD per booked container) | Ninety-day no-show tally that closes the product to new requests |
|---|---|---|
| AHL Spot Saver | 500.00 | 2 |
| AHL Spot Flex | 400.00 | 2 |
| AHL Contract Booking | 300.00 | 3 |
| AHL Contract Priority | 250.00 | 3 |
| AHL Guaranteed Loading | 750.00 | 2 |
| AHL Premium Express | 900.00 | 2 |

## Notes

- The contract-rated products tolerate one more no-show than the others before refusing a new request.
- The premium products carry the steepest per-container fees: 750.00 for AHL Guaranteed Loading and 900.00 for AHL Premium Express.

**Hypothetical example.** A customer with two no-show fees in the trailing 90 days has reached the figure of 2 set for AHL Spot Saver, AHL Spot Flex, AHL Guaranteed Loading and AHL Premium Express, but remains under the figure of 3 set for AHL Contract Booking and AHL Contract Priority. The history described is invented.
